clue.text: Bureaucrats offer courteous assistance

definitions.meaning: government administrators collectively make up this body of officials
read literally, polite help given to someone

explanation.walkthrough: 'offer' is only a link joining the two senses.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the body of state officials, and the phrase taken word by word as polite help.

clue.text: Trains and buses

definitions.meaning: to train is to tutor or instruct
long-distance buses and railway carriages share this name

explanation.definitionFit: A tutor instructs (trains) pupils, and long-distance road vehicles are the second sense.

clue.text: View old road intersected by small street

indicators.note: intersected by means the road is cut into by the next piece

parts.note: a via is a Roman road
St is the short form of street

explanation.surface: A scene of an ancient road crossed by a lane.
explanation.walkthrough: 'old road' points to a Roman road, the Latin word for way.
explanation.definitionFit: A vista is a scenic prospect, a view.

clue.text: Former dress of night workers

parts.note: late can mean former, as in the late chairman
a shift is a simple straight dress

explanation.surface: A garment once worn by those working at night.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Former' gives LATE, as in 'the late president'.
explanation.definitionFit: The team clocking on in the evening, working through the dark hours.

clue.text: Dash to get porter back before noon

indicators.note: back means the drink's name is read in reverse

parts.note: porter is a dark beer, a kind of ale

explanation.surface: Rushing to fetch a hotel porter back before midday.
explanation.walkthrough: Porter here is the dark beer, not a hotel worker; 'before' is just a link placing the drink ahead of noon.
explanation.definitionFit: Dash as flair and verve, a synonym.

clue.text: Peer is a force to reckon with

parts.note: vis is Latin for force
to count is to reckon

explanation.surface: A nobleman is a power to be taken seriously.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is a' links; VIS is Latin for force, familiar from 'vis-a-vis' type phrases in physics.
explanation.definitionFit: A noble ranking above baron is a member of the peerage.

clue.text: First-rate report

definitions.meaning: excellent, as in a top-notch regiment
a loud bang such as a gunshot

explanation.definitionFit: Excellent as an adjective, and a sharp sudden noise as a noun.

clue.text: Name best used for underground floor

indicators.note: used signals the letters are worked over into a new order

explanation.surface: Picking a good name for the lower level of a building.
explanation.walkthrough: 'used' rearranges NAME BEST.
explanation.definitionFit: The storey below ground level is the lowest floor of a house.

clue.text: Taunted for having back-combed one's hair?

definitions.meaning: hair combed backwards to give volume is said to be ruffled up this way

explanation.definitionFit: Mocked someone, and hair fluffed by back-combing, two senses of one verb.

clue.text: Hounds crazy assailant

indicators.note: crazy tells us the letters of the next word go wild and rearrange

explanation.surface: Dogs chase a deranged attacker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crazy' rearranges ASSAILANT.
explanation.definitionFit: German shepherd dogs, a breed of large dog, are hounds in the loose sense.

clue.text: Native American loses aspiration quickly

indicators.note: loses tells us a letter is dropped from the tribe's name

parts.note: the Apache are a Native American people
aspiration is the breathed sound written as the letter H

explanation.surface: A Native American speaker drops his aitches in a hurry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loses' takes H out of APACHE.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean at speed, swiftly.

clue.text: Gruff man carrying paddles

indicators.note: carrying means the pronoun holds the other word within it

parts.note: he is the pronoun for a man
oars are paddles for rowing

explanation.surface: A rough-voiced man rows his boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gruff' looks like a description of the man, but it is the definition of a rough voice.
explanation.definitionFit: A rough, husky voice is gruff.

clue.text: Always in favour of strong defences

parts.note: for means supporting, in favour of
keeps are the fortified towers of castles

explanation.surface: Someone who is forever pro fortification.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means permanently, for good.

clue.text: Sally appears in cravats or ties

indicators.note: appears in says the word sits inside the run of clue words

explanation.surface: A girl called Sally shows up wearing neckwear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'appears in' signals the run hidden across cravatS OR TIEs.
explanation.definitionFit: A sally is a sudden sortie by troops from a besieged place; the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: Phone fellow about independent electric supplier

parts.note: to ring is to phone

indicators.note: about means the man surrounds the next letter

parts.note: a fellow is a man

explanation.surface: Calling a man about an independent energy company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts I inside MAN. A ring main is a British household wiring circuit feeding the sockets.
explanation.definitionFit: A domestic circuit of cable feeding power sockets supplies electricity around a house.

clue.text: Propose to admit cardinal eventually

indicators.note: to admit means the verb lets the other piece in

parts.note: to propose doing something is to intend it
HE stands for His Eminence, the title of a cardinal

explanation.surface: A suitor plans to let a churchman into the conversation at last.
explanation.walkthrough: His Eminence is how a cardinal is addressed, so 'cardinal' gives its initials.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means finally, after a long time.

clue.text: Patrimony includes many a secluded retreat

indicators.note: includes means the inheritance word holds the next letter

parts.note: patrimony is inheritance, heritage
M, the Roman numeral for a thousand, stands for many

explanation.surface: An inheritance that features a quiet hideaway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'includes' puts M inside HERITAGE; 'a' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A recluse's dwelling place is a remote retreat.

clue.text: This cape is made in imitation of others' style

indicators.note: made signals the letters are put together afresh in another order

explanation.surface: A cloak tailored to copy another designer's look.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made' rearranges THIS CAPE.
explanation.definitionFit: A work that copies another artist's manner is a deliberate homage.

clue.text: Mo digests one article giving full details

indicators.note: digests means the word for a short time swallows the others

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a minute
I is the Roman numeral for one
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Someone called Mo takes in a single piece of writing to get every detail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'digests' puts I and A inside MINUTE; 'Mo' is slang for a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Minutiae are the small, precise particulars of something.

clue.text: Exotic birds' stomachs contain little calcium

definitions.note: the possessive joins the definition to the wordplay; the plural birds themselves are meant

indicators.note: contain means the stomachs hold the element's symbol

parts.note: maws are stomachs or gullets
Ca is the chemical symbol, a short form, for calcium

explanation.surface: Tropical birds' guts hold a trace of calcium.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in 'birds'' is surface glue; the definition is the plural birds.
explanation.definitionFit: Large colourful parrots from Central and South America.

clue.text: Censorious reviewer

parts.note: a reviewer who finds fault, judging works of art or performances

explanation.definitionFit: A faultfinder and a professional judge of books or plays share this one name.

clue.text: Top-class investments

definitions.meaning: money or assets invested in a business

explanation.definitionFit: Excellent in old slang, and wealth put into a business, two senses.

clue.text: Holiday area — quiet spot beyond the river

indicators.note: beyond means the following pieces come after the river

parts.note: the Cam is the river that flows through Cambridge
p is the musical marking piano, quiet
a site is a spot or place

explanation.surface: A peaceful place for a holiday across the river.
explanation.walkthrough: The river is the one flowing through Cambridge; 'quiet' is the musical marking piano.
explanation.definitionFit: A place for tents and caravans is where holidaymakers stay.

clue.text: Second XI displays vigour

parts.note: XI is eleven, a cricket or football side

explanation.surface: A reserve side shows plenty of energy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Second XI' looks like a reserve side; 'displays' links. XI is a team of eleven.
explanation.definitionFit: Energy or momentum, as in running out of puff.

clue.text: Minor problem caused by this Roman goblet

parts.note: hic is Latin, the Romans' language, for this
a goblet is a drinking cup

explanation.surface: A small accident with an ancient Roman drinking vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Roman' points to Latin, where HIC means 'this'.
explanation.definitionFit: A hitch or minor setback, as in a small glitch in plans.

clue.text: Cuff curly-headed boor

indicators.note: headed means only the leading letter of curly is taken

parts.note: a lout is a boor

explanation.surface: Slapping a lout with curly hair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'headed' takes C, the head of 'curly'.
explanation.definitionFit: A cuff is a blow with the hand, a whack.

clue.text: Like knocking back Italian wine

parts.note: as means like

indicators.note: knocking back means the abbreviation is reversed

explanation.surface: Downing an Italian sparkling drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocking back' turns IT into TI; 'knocking back' also suggests drinking.
explanation.definitionFit: A sparkling white from Piedmont is an Italian wine.

clue.text: Compose text for occidental ceremony

parts.note: occidental means western, abbreviated W
a rite is a ceremony

explanation.surface: Drafting the wording for a Western ritual.
explanation.definitionFit: To set down words or author something is to compose it.

clue.text: Search for players prior to a match

parts.note: the cast are the actors in a play
a bout is a contest or match

explanation.surface: A team looks for players ahead of a fixture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prior to' is just a link here, keeping the pieces in clue order.
explanation.definitionFit: To hunt around or look widely for something is to search.

clue.text: Luggage left behind proves obstructive

indicators.note: behind means the letter comes after the luggage word

parts.note: impedimenta is baggage or equipment carried along

explanation.surface: Bags abandoned in transit get in the way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'behind' puts L after IMPEDIMENTA, a word for baggage that hinders travel.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that hinders or gets in the way is obstructive.
